subject.title: Codex dynamic tools should normalize raw plugin payloads

question: Which open raw-payload normalization PR should become the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same source-reproducible crash, but one is conflicting/proof-gated and the other is behind with a prior serialization finding, so automation should not pick the branch for maintainers.

options.title: Repair and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916
options.body: Use the formally linked branch that downstream proof says moved past the reduce crash, after resolving conflicts and attaching accessible redacted proof.

options.title: Repair and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97917
options.body: Use the smaller alternate branch only after fixing total serialization and adding real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer writes the exact bridge-boundary normalization contract.

recommendation.title: Repair and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916
recommendation.body: Use the formally linked branch that downstream proof says moved past the reduce crash, after resolving conflicts and attaching accessible redacted proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on the Codex dynamic-tool bridge and adjacent result-middleware path.
